for every route address and every market id (dex row +0x30 * 10000 + index): add the address to set +0x188, get or make its position row, tag 1 with margin or size != 0 = 0x21 with the id; tag 1 and empty = rewritten as tag 0, leverage 20, words +0x10..+0x37 zero, +0x38 = 50; the total row of the id is rewritten with the same size, and a leverage change is noted at +0x128
read once before the arms with (flag, id); the word is kept for step 13
one plan row: id -> (size, margin +0x8, oracle * size). Oracle row = dex +0x68 + (id % 10000) * 0x60, word +0x20; negative or a product overflow panics; a missing id panics; tag byte 0 panics
summary word 0 and word 2 go into the plan row list; rows of 0x20 (id, size, margin share, value) are sorted by insertion below 21 rows and bulk built
the list leaves a remainder in summary word 0. Nonzero: added to the middle word of the first plan row with saturation; no rows: kept for the default receiver
route map id -> address, else the default at route +0x30

first use of a receiver clones its account into a map keyed by address; rows run in id order; size += row size saturating; a change clears +0x28, a sign change clears +0x20; 0 to nonzero adds to the count saturating, nonzero to 0 subtracts when above 0; balance += middle word saturating; remainder goes to the default clone balance
in address order: word 1 of the clone summary below 0 panics; word 0 - word 1 saturating below 0 = 0x22 with nothing written to accounts; steps 2 and its set adds stay

one row of 0x68 per receiver in address order: flag, id, item vector, id word from exchange +0x40 taken at first use saturating, +0x30 unsigned sum of |value| saturating, +0x38 sum of value + middle word saturating, receiver +0x40, user +0x54; remainder adds to +0x38 of the default row, making one when absent

in address order the clone replaces the account: every old size leaves the id total, every new size enters it; an id with a new leverage moves its note under +0x128 when that map holds address and id; old +0x28 dropped; count 0 to nonzero adds to set +0x158, nonzero to 0 removes
user added to set +0x188; size, +0x20, +0x28 and margin of that id are zero; count falls by 1 when size was nonzero and count above 0; total falls by |size|. Balance stays
every tag 0 row: size, +0x20, +0x28 zero and count falls by 1 floor 0 when size was nonzero; total falls by |size|, the row is kept; isolated rows stay; then the user joins set +0x188 and balance = 0
user count nonzero to 0 removes from +0x158, 0 to nonzero adds
account value below 0: dex row +0x248 falls by its size, floor 0; i64::MIN panics. Returns 0x186 with the rows
